### Polaris Expands Call of Duty® Collaboration as Polaris DAGOR Joins Modern Warfare® 4


October 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/608247098/files/doc_news/Polaris-Expands-Call-of-Duty-Collaboration-as-Polaris-DAGOR-Joins-Modern-Warfare-4-2026.pdf)


***Longstanding collaboration continues to bridge real-world Polaris performance with one of gaming's most iconic franchises***


MINNEAPOLIS


, Oct. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII), the global leader in powersports, today announced the[Polaris DAGOR](https://military.polaris.com/en-us/dagor/) is joining *Call of Duty* ® *: Modern Warfare 4* as a playable in-game vehicle. Building on Polaris' growing presence within one of the world's most recognizable gaming franchises, the integration marks the latest milestone in the company's ongoing collaboration with *Call of Duty* ®, bringing Polaris' performance and capability to millions of players worldwide.


Experience the full interactive Multichannel News Release here:[https://www.multivu.com/polaris/9376251-en-polaris-expands-call-of-duty-collaboration-dagor-joins-modern-warfare-4](https://www.multivu.com/polaris/9376251-en-polaris-expands-call-of-duty-collaboration-dagor-joins-modern-warfare-4)


Following the introduction of the Polaris RZR Pro R in 2024 and Sportsman XP 1000 in 2025, DAGOR introduces players to a different side of Polaris' off-road engineering: a lightweight military platform designed for rapid transport, maneuverability and mission-focused mobility in demanding environments.


"What began as a key activation within our Virtual Meets Reality strategy has evolved into a broader partnership that allows us to bring the Polaris brand and our innovation portfolio to new audiences in immersive ways," said Holly Spaeth, Vice President, Off-Road and Polaris Brand Marketing. "The addition of DAGOR expands that vision, giving players a broader look at our vehicle portfolio and a new way to experience the mobility, capability and performance engineered for demanding environments."


Polaris designers worked closely with *Call of Duty* ® developers at Infinity Ward to help recreate the DAGOR's appearance and capabilities in-game, continuing the collaborative approach used with previous vehicle integrations. DAGOR marks the third Polaris vehicle to join the franchise, following the RZR Pro R and Sportsman XP 1000. Since the first integration, the relationship has grown beyond in-game vehicles to include real-world fan experiences, connecting the worlds of gaming, powersports and sports.


Earlier this year, Polaris and *Call of Dut* y® brought the partnership off the screen and into the real world at Fanatics Fest NYC through the "[Path to Victory](https://www.instagram.com/p/Da-9jf8RXb3/) " activation, where attendees experienced Polaris RZR vehicles firsthand on a custom off-road course built in the heart of Manhattan.


"Our partnership with Polaris continues to give us new ways to bring authentic, real-world vehicles into the *Call of Duty* ® experience," said Cody Neal, Director of Global Partnerships, Activision. "The DAGOR is a natural fit for *Modern Warfare 4* , bringing the capability, performance and distinctive design of a real military vehicle into the game in a way that feels true to both brands."


The DAGOR is playable from day one in *Call of Duty* ® *: Modern Warfare 4* , launching today, October 23, and arrives in *Call of Duty* ® *: Warzone®* with Season 1 on November 6.


In honor of Veterans Day and those who have served, Polaris and the Call of Duty® Endowment will host an in-game community mission from November 11 through November 25. Once players collectively complete 5 million DAGOR rides across Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty®: Warzone, Polaris will donate $25,000 to the Endowment, and one follower of the Call of Duty® Endowment's social media channels will be selected to go from the game to real life with a Polaris Adventures off-road ride experience.


For more information about Polaris and its portfolio of powersports vehicles, visit[Polaris.com](https://www.polaris.com/en-us/) .


**More about the Polaris DAGOR**
Built for missions, the Polaris DAGOR is an ultra-light, open-frame military vehicle designed to move personnel and equipment quickly across challenging terrain and into hard-to-reach locations. Built to be flown in, not driven in, DAGOR can be transported inside a CH-47 Chinook or sling-loaded beneath a UH-60 Black Hawk. While not available for consumer purchase, DAGOR gives *Call of Duty* ® players a rare look at the military side of Polaris' off-road engineering and capability. For more information on the performance and capabilities of the Polaris DAGOR, please visit[our website](https://military.polaris.com/en-us/dagor/features/) .


**About Polaris**
As the global leader in powersports, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) pioneers product breakthroughs and enriching experiences and services that have invited people to discover the joy of being outdoors since our founding in 1954. Polaris' high-quality product line-up includes the RANGER, RZR, Polaris XPEDITION, and GENERAL side-by-side off-road vehicles; Sportsman all-terrain off-road vehicles; military and commercial off-road vehicles; snowmobiles; Slingshot moto-roadsters; Aixam quadricycles; Goupil electric vehicles; and pontoon and deck boats, including industry-leading Bennington pontoons. Polaris enhances the riding experience with a robust portfolio of parts, garments, and accessories. Headquartered in Minnesota, Polaris serves nearly 100 countries across the globe.[www.polaris.com](https://www.polaris.com/en-us/)
